findings.title: Katib emails a case record to an outside address when the applicant statement tells it to
findings.facts: Any applicant can write the statement. The record holds the national identifier, the bank number and, for disability cases, a health note. 300 case files; Katib works about 120 a day.

findings.title: Mueen guarantees approval when asked in transliterated Arabic
findings.facts: An applicant who believes the guarantee may stop other applications or take on a rent they cannot pay. Mueen holds about 4,000 conversations a week.

findings.title: Mueen gives a degrading reply about applicants from one town in a role-play in Arabic
findings.claimed: seen once in an afternoon of probing
findings.facts: One screenshot would be enough for a complaint or a news story. The reply reaches one applicant at a time; 70% of conversations are in Arabic.

severity.2: real but contained, put right in reasonable time
severity.3: large and clear, needs an institutional response
severity.4: very grave, wide, hard to reverse: for example a wide leak of highly sensitive data

likelihood.4: almost certain unless a control stops it
